steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game environment art for Heroes of Orvesk, dark gothic fantasy painted realism. Natural large masses and convincing volume, restrained textured brushwork, aged materials, muted earth/olive/charcoal/stone palette, upper-left daylight, readable middle-dark values, atmospheric depth without washed-out whitening. Never photorealistic drone photography, flat vector art, cute cartoon, plastic 3D, neon, modern objects, sci-fi, heroic saturated colors. No characters, creatures, text, labels, UI, markers, circles, graph nodes, frames, watermarks or vignette. Full-bleed opaque image; fill every edge with environment, no black fades. Asset type: separate ground-level combat-screen landscape backdrop of the same region, not an overhead map. Create ONE landscape image, requested exact 1672 x 941 pixels, approximately 16:9. Wide eye-level environmental view. Calm lower-center ground and subdued mid/upper-center backdrop for a separate game interface, but NOT a deliberately flat rectangular empty area. Place most intricate texture at the sides and middle distance; retain recognizable material and architectural features through a narrow center crop too. No painted battlefield grid, empty round combat arena or laid-out path. Scene: Ground-level view of a quiet enclosed town courtyard with stained limestone walls, timber upper stories and dark slate roofs. A closed inn door and a modest linen market canopy appear in middle distance; worn cobbles underfoot, weak daylight through overcast air. Broad calm central foreground, no crowd, no readable signs, no skyline-dominating cathedral. Regional continuity: Perevalets, an inhabited but bleak walled medieval trading town under strain from war. Dense irregular quarters of weathered limestone and dark timber houses with grey steep slate roofs and modest gothic arches, shuttered windows, enclosed courtyards with stone paving, small linen market awnings, an austere charitable infirmary and a modest inn among normal houses. City-wall towers and a gate are distributed along one side. Architecture is mostly intact, signs of neglect rather than a ruined city. Rooftops, walls and courtyards remain visible across the center, dark narrow gaps between quarters, no grand central square as a play arena.
notes: Exact copies of generated originals. Map outputs were 1402x1122 rather than requested 3000x2400; actual dimensions recorded in the catalog. No stretching, cropping or repainting. Mobile delivery copies are produced by the existing sync_content.py pipeline.
Accepted: location matches chapter, no UI or itinerary, opaque, map and battle view share palette and materials.
